claims.evidence: combined.zip experimentalDesignTemplate.txt names 8 SILAC experiments A-I (no H) with run names F090801_Dir1_*, F091104_Dir1b_*, F090807_Dir2_*, F090804_Rev1_*, F090925_Rev1b_*, F091127_Dir2b_*, F101215_Dir2_*, F101217_Rev1_* (renamed from the deposited RAW names; mapping by date + OFFGEL well in filemap.tsv; 2010 sets suffixed -Sort3 after the deposited names "..._Sort3_NN" to keep the two "Dir2"/"Rev1" names distinct). Each experiment is one heavy+light SILAC mixture, so one source per (experiment, channel) = one physical labelled cell population. combined_onetoone.zip experiment "Ele" = the WT:WT 1:1 triplicate (paper Methods); its heavy and light populations are one source each, measured in three technical series.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 45 of 276 RAW files are excluded and blocked (BLOCKED.md): MaxQuant experiment "Lele" of combined_onetoone.zip = f080904TB_yeast_2567_01..15 (15) and f080917TB_2567_1b..15b + 1c..15c (30). They are SILAC (Multiplicity 2, Arg10;Lys8) with H/L ~1 (median log2 0.003, sd 0.37), but the paper does not describe a 2008 experiment, the word "yeast" in 15 names is unexplained (possible yeast spike or different design), and the cells/channels are undocumented. The paper's WT:WT triplicate matches "Ele" (3 x 15 fractions), not "Lele".

Reverse (Rev1, Rev1b, Rev1-Sort3) channel map: no sentence in the paper states the swapped orientation; it rests on the deposited "Rev"/"Rev1bis" names plus inverted ratios of the Western-blot-validated targets (Pbk, Ptk2b, Htra2, Aifm1, Gmfb, Pfkp, Ppp2r2a, Bax) and negative global correlation with the Dir experiments. The paper's general statement (L = control, H = miR) holds for the Dir experiments only.

Biological replicate structure: the paper mentions two quantified sets "#2567-1" and "#2567-2" (analysed separately) and "multiple biological replicates", but does not say which MaxQuant experiments belong to which set, nor whether Dir1b/Dir2b/Rev1bis are new cultures or re-preparations of Dir1/Dir2/Rev1 lysates. Each of the 8 mixtures got its own number (1-8 per group); this may over-count independent cultures if b/bis are re-preparations. Not encoded: #2567-1/#2567-2 membership (2010 "Sort3" sets may be #2567-2 — unverified).
WT:WT (Ele) genotype "wild type" follows the Methods wording "WT:WT cells"; Supp Fig 4a calls them "control cells". Whether these were uninfected or empty-vector #2567 cells is not stated.
